pooltable.mode.solo.name: Solo Challenge
pooltable.mode.solo.desc: Pocket all 15 balls in as few shots as possible. A scratch adds 2 shots. Your best score is saved.
pooltable.mode.eight.name: 8-Ball
pooltable.mode.eight.desc: Solids vs stripes; with 4 or 6 players it is played in teams (alternating turns). Pocket the 8-ball last to win.
pooltable.mode.nine.name: 9-Ball
pooltable.mode.nine.desc: Balls 1 to 9 only. Always hit the lowest ball first; pocket the 9 without a foul to win.
pooltable.mode.rotation.name: Rotation to 61
pooltable.mode.rotation.desc: 15 balls, hit the lowest first, each ball is worth its number. First to 61 points wins.
